Introducing Tabletop, a collaborative space from @GoogleLabs where you can create custom tools to build, plan, and do more with your friends, family, or club.

Send an invite to your group and start a shared hub where everyone can contribute simultaneously for your next trip, potluck, or fantasy league. You can create live dinner polls, trip itineraries, expense splitters, and sports brackets tailored to your group.

AlphaGenome 2 is our new AI model that zooms in on specific cells to help scientists understand what drives disease. 🧵 https://t.co/CkpKgsutf3
